svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Hardwood strip 45 wide, 300 long, planed to 5.3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The right thickness is 18 mm (the worktop) less the tile's real

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thickness: measure the tile and the worktop first and plane to suit,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the tile sits flush with the plywood.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: glued to the top of each of the two tile rails, centred on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail, running front to back under the tile pocket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 8.5 mm insert holes go through it in step 10, 125 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both packers the same thickness within 0.05 mm.
